results.name: Domains
results.cypher: MATCH (n:Domain) RETURN n.name AS domain, n.objectid AS sid ORDER BY domain

results.name: Kerberoastable users
results.cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.hasspn = true AND u.enabled = true RETURN count(u) AS kerberoastable

results.name: AS-REP roastable users
results.cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.dontreqpreauth = true AND u.enabled = true RETURN count(u) AS asrep_roastable

results.name: AdminCount users
results.cypher: MATCH (u:User) WHERE u.admincount = true RETURN count(u) AS admin_count_users

results.name: Unconstrained delegation computers
results.cypher: MATCH (c:Computer) WHERE c.unconstraineddelegation = true RETURN count(c) AS unconstrained

results.name: Enabled domain admin users
results.cypher: MATCH (u:User)-[:MemberOf*1..]->(g:Group) WHERE g.objectid ENDS WITH '-512' AND u.enabled = true RETURN count(DISTINCT u) AS domain_admins

results.name: Distinct relationship types
results.cypher: MATCH ()-[r]->() RETURN DISTINCT type(r) AS relationType ORDER BY relationType
